description: This Java class 'SetTimerActivity' sets a timer in an Android wearable app, providing UI for selecting timer durations, scheduling alarms, and managing notifications.

classes.name: ListViewItem
classes.description: Model class representing a timer option with label and duration.

classes.name: TimerWearableListViewAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying timer options in a wearable list view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up timer options or starts a timer if duration is provided.

methods.name: setupTimer
methods.description: Sets up an alarm and notification for the specified duration.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on timer options, initiating timer setup.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty handler for clicks on empty list regions.

methods.name: registerWithAlarmManager
methods.description: Schedules an alarm with AlarmManager to trigger when timer expires.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Creates a notification with actions for the timer countdown.
